title: Plant Manager I
text:
**Job Details:**

At Tyson Foods, we believe that our team members are the heart of our success. Are you ready to take on a dynamic role where you can make a significant impact? Join Our Team in the Prepared Foods Division as a Plant Manager I!

 

**Setting the table for your success** :

At Tyson Foods, our team members’ health and wellness is very important to us. We believe in helping our team members thrive inside and outside of the workplace. That’s why we’re committed to providing a holistic benefits package that provides support for you and your family.

 

We invest in our team members and their success by providing resources like **BENEFITS ON DAY ONE OF EMPLOYMENT and FREE EDUCATION!**

 

Benefits include medical/Rx, dental, and vision coverage; 9 paid holidays; [4] weeks paid vacation upon hire, plus earned time off; 401(k) with employer match; stock purchase program; and product purchase program. We also offer **CAREER GROWTH** and much more!

 

Summary: This facility is part of our Prepared Foods business unit and manufactures cooked Philly Steak. Looking for a leader to fill the Plant Manager role for this well-established facility through significant changes to the overall business.

 

**RESPONSIBILITIES** :

* Leadership & Safety
* Be a safety leader at the plant, establishing and directing plant policies and procedures.
* Maintain a clean and safe working environment, ensuring compliance with all federal, state, and company regulations.
* Establish and foster a team environment, promoting a positive culture.
* Operations & Production Management
* Direct and coordinate all plant operations and maintenance, adhering to company policies and procedures.
* Oversee and achieve plant production goals.
* Establish production schedules across all shifts to meet demand.
* Quality & Customer Relations
* Ensure product quality standards are met and maintained.
* Work directly with customers and suppliers to meet expectations and support operational needs.
* Staffing & Development
* Select, train, and manage plant supervisory and operations staff.
* Conduct employee performance reviews and support career development.
* Schedule and lead regular plant meetings to support communication and planning.
* Cross-Departmental Coordination
* Collaborate with department heads to coordinate safety, purchasing, production, quality, HR, accounting, and shipping.
* Community & Corporate Engagement
* Establish and maintain positive relationships within the community.
* Attend scheduled corporate training and meetings.
Other Duties: Perform other duties as assigned. 

 

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Education: Associate or bachelor’s degree required.
* Experience: At least four years of plant management experience required to include progressive levels of responsibility. Direction of plant operations and supply chain knowledge helpful. Lean experience is preferred. Capital project management experience is preferred.
* Computer Skills: Good computer skills including Microsoft Office Suite.
* Communication Skills: Good verbal and written skills. Bilingual is preferred.
* Supervisory: Yes.
* Travel: 3 - 6 trips per year domestic and possible international trips.

All professional team members are expected to demonstrate responsible use of approved AI tools, including safeguarding sensitive information, adhering to company policies, and validating AI-generated outputs. Individual Contributors should demonstrate the ability to integrate AI into daily work, improve efficiency through AI-enabled solutions, evaluate outputs critically, and apply professional judgment when using AI. People Leaders should demonstrate the ability to drive responsible AI adoption, enable effective use of approved solutions, identify opportunities to improve team performance through AI, and ensure accountability for the quality and accuracy of AI-supported outcomes.

**Relocation Assistance Eligible:**

Yes

**Work Shift:**

1ST SHIFT (United States of America)

**Pay Range/Rate:**

$129,000.00 - $215,000.00

**Incentives:**

Annual Incentive Plan:

Yes

Long-Term Incentive Plan:

No

**Certain roles at Tyson require background checks. If you are offered a position that requires a background check you will be provided additional documentation to complete once an offer has been extended.**

Any listed amounts represent the base pay range. Additional compensation may be available for this position based on various factors such as shift differentials, standby/on-call, overtime, premiums, extra shift incentives, or bonuses. Pay is just one part of Tyson’s total compensation package.

 
 

***Tyson will develop an offer based on a candidate's or team member’s relevant skills and capabilities, the market data for the role described in this requisition, internal equity, and other information relevant to the candidate and role.***

 

Hourly Applicants ONLY -You must complete the task after submitting your application to provide additional information to be considered for employment.

 
 

The successful candidate(s) must be willing and able to perform the physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation.

 
 

Tyson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, national origin, color, religion, age, genetics, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status.
